title: Hexagonal Contributor License — KADEEZY MUSIC: Consent-First Contributor Template (11.MSBGL.KADEEZY.LIC.01)
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
This contributor-license template defines a consent-first path for music and critical analysis to enter the Crimson Hexagonal Archive through Maybe Space Baby Garden Lanes. It is designed for KADEEZY MUSIC and separates rights in the artist’s audio, lyrics, performance, and visuals from rights in the archive’s computational audial criticism, provenance anchor, visualization, and commentary.

Consent is track-specific. Before any proposed deposit, the artist must receive the title, the materials to be made public, a plain summary of the deposit, and the proposed identifier. Approval for one track does not authorize another. If the artist is under eighteen, the template requires both the artist’s assent and consent from a parent or legal guardian. Guardian approval does not replace the artist’s own decision.

The default rights structure leaves the artist’s work all rights reserved, licenses the archive’s analysis under CC BY 4.0, treats lyric excerpts as reproduced by permission rather than relicensed, and makes image use platform-dependent and consent-sensitive. Separate written consent is required before any AI training on the artist’s work. The template also offers withdrawal procedures, a choice about retaining or removing analysis, and an artist-specific hex prefix.

The body’s consent ledger is blank and says the template activates only after review and authorization. It is therefore a proposed license, not evidence that a license was accepted or any track was authorized. The promises require legal review. A minor’s contractual capacity, guardian authority, withdrawal rights, public-repository persistence, fair use, and the effect of earlier open licenses vary by jurisdiction and platform.

wiki_article:
**Hexagonal Contributor License — KADEEZY MUSIC** is a consent-first template for depositing an artist’s work and archive criticism through Maybe Space Baby Garden Lanes.

It requires separate approval for every track and, if the artist is a minor, both artist assent and guardian consent. The artist retains copyright in music, lyrics, and performance, while archive analysis is separately licensed.

The template prohibits AI training without additional written permission and proposes withdrawal and privacy protections.

The consent table is blank. The document is a proposed framework, not proof that the artist accepted the terms or authorized a deposit.
